title: Nike and FC Barcelona Unveil an Exclusive Collection With Tyler, The Creator Ahead of El Clásico
summary: The Nike x FC Barcelona x GOLF WANG (GOLF) collection features 11 pieces that merge the Catalan club’s identity with the creative universe of Tyler, The Creator.
body_markdown:
Nike and FC Barcelona are unveiling a new exclusive collection in collaboration with Tyler, The Creator, one of the most influential artists in contemporary music and culture. The launch celebrates El Clásico and aims to take the passion for football beyond the pitch, connecting it with music, local culture, fashion and creativity.


The Nike x FC Barcelona x GOLF WANG (GOLF) collection features 11 pieces and brings together two worlds with distinct identities. On one side, FC Barcelona’s heritage and culture; on the other, the creative vision of Tyler, The Creator, an artist who has developed a distinctive aesthetic and made originality and freedom of expression defining elements of his identity.


The collection brings this vision into the world of fashion, aiming to connect Barça’s identity with new generations and cultural communities around the world.


The collection is built around one central idea: “It means more than just fútbol.” Created for one of the biggest nights in the football calendar, it unites football culture, music and creativity for the love of the game.


The launch will be accompanied by a special initiative in Barcelona, where fans will be able to discover the collection and take part in a range of cultural experiences during the 10 days leading up to El Clásico.


**(The) Creator’s Àgora: 10 days of culture, music and creativity in Barcelona**


From October 15 through 25, Carrer de Boters, 4, in the heart of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, will be transformed into (The) Creator’s Àgora, a cultural space brought to life by Nike, FC Barcelona and Spotify, connecting Tyler, The Creator’s creative universe with local talent and the city’s football culture.


The initiative aims to celebrate Barcelona’s cultural identity and spotlight its creative communities. Beyond showcasing the new collection, the space is designed as a meeting point where art and music intersect with football and fashion.


The project will be creatively directed by Daniel2000 (Daniel Dalfó), a multidisciplinary artist based in Barcelona. His deep understanding of the city’s cultural scene will help connect Tyler, The Creator’s international influence with a new generation of Barcelona-based artists and creatives.


Throughout the 10-day opening period, visitors will be able to enjoy a program of activities and experiences exploring the relationship between football and creativity across different disciplines.


Highlights include a sculptural installation by Sofía Alazraki, who will incorporate pieces from the collection into the art. The space will also feature a photography gallery showcasing local creatives whose images capture how the passion for FC Barcelona is experienced across the city’s streets and communities.


Further, the artistic program will feature installations by Clàudia Aguiló Vidal and Victoria Valentina; an artist residency by La galería de Arte Barsa; and performances by Candela Capitán and Leon Guallart on piano. The photography exhibition will bring together works by Anna Izquierdo, Meteo Quindos and Aleix Barau, while graphic design will be led by LaFolie.


Music will also take center stage, featuring DJ sets by John Heaven, Nil Fee and Yung Prado, alongside a selection of music and audiovisual content.


In addition, (The) Creator’s Àgora will feature a dedicated area for displaying and selling the new collection, giving fans the opportunity to discover the different pieces from this collaboration up close.


The space will be located at 4 Carrer de Boters, Barcelona, and will be open from October 15 through 25, Monday to Saturday from 11 am to 9 pm and Sundays from 12 pm to 8 pm


**A celebration of football culture beyond the pitch**


With this launch, Nike is reinforcing its commitment to connecting football with new forms of cultural expression and bringing FC Barcelona closer to generations who express their passion for the club through music, fashion and art.


The initiative will culminate on October 25, coinciding with El Clásico, one of the most internationally recognized fixtures in football. For 10 days, Barcelona will become the stage for a celebration of football culture beyond the pitch.


The collection is available at (The) Creator’s Àgora, select Nike retail locations, Barça Stores and the Club’s official e-commerce platform, as well as[golfwang.com](https://golfwang.com/) and GOLF stores in Los Angeles, New York, Tokyo, Sydney and London. The collection will be available soon at[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/) and[SNKRS](https://www.nike.com/launch) .
